item.title: Packt Publishing Launches Workshop to Build Private, Production‑Ready AI Assistants
item.description:
Packt Publishing Launches Workshop to Build Private, Production‑Ready AI Assistants

Packt Publishing announced an intensive 4‑hour online workshop that teaches participants how to build and deploy a privacy‑focused AI assistant that runs entirely on their own infrastructure.

🔍 Overview

  • Build a production‑ready, privacy‑focused AI assistant that runs entirely on your own infrastructure.
  • The workshop is delivered online and lasts four hours.
  • No cloud APIs or external dependencies are required, giving you full control over your data.

🛠️ How it Works

  • Start with OpenClaw configuration to manage local large language models.
  • Run and manage local LLMs using Docker Model Runner.
  • Follow a complete deployment pipeline that includes security hardening and integration with messaging platforms such as WhatsApp or Telegram.

⚙️ Key Details

  • Duration: 4‑hour intensive online session.
  • Requirements: Docker installed on your laptop; minimum 16 GB RAM recommended for smooth local inference.
  • Outcome: A fully functional local AI assistant running on your machine.

🚀 What You’ll Get

  • A working assistant running locally, configured with OpenClaw and Docker.
  • Integration with your choice of messaging platform.
  • Understanding of security and privacy implications.
  • A reusable architecture you can adapt for future AI projects.

💡 Why It Matters

  • Most AI assistants today rely on external APIs, creating concerns around privacy, cost, and data control.
  • This workshop teaches a different approach: building a private AI assistant that runs entirely on your local machine, giving you full ownership of infrastructure and data.

#AIassistant #PrivacyAI #OpenClaw #Docker #AIWorkshop

Source: Build, Run and Deploy AI Agents with OpenClaw & Docker Model Runner

item.title: CapRover Scalable PaaS for Application and Database Deployment
item.description:
CapRover Scalable PaaS for Application and Database Deployment

CapRover is a scalable Platform as a Service (PaaS) designed as an easy-to-use app/database deployment and web server manager that automates Docker and nginx.

🔍 Overview

CapRover provides a platform for deploying applications and databases without requiring Docker or nginx knowledge. It is designed for developers who prefer writing code over managing server configurations and those seeking to reduce costs compared to services like Heroku or Microsoft Azure.

🧩 How it works

CapRover utilizes several technologies under its interface to maintain robustness and speed:

Component Purpose
Docker Swarm Containerization and clustering
Nginx Load-balancing (via fully customizable templates)
Let’s Encrypt Free SSL (HTTPS)
NetData Performance monitoring

⚙️ Key details

CapRover supports a wide range of applications and databases, including:

  • Languages/Frameworks: NodeJS, Python, PHP, ASP.NET, Ruby
  • Databases: MariaDB, MySQL, MongoDB, Postgres
  • CMS: WordPress

Key features include:

  • Web GUI for convenience and a CLI for automation and scripting.
  • Dropdown-based installation for databases like MariaDB, MySQL, and MongoDB.
  • No lock-in; applications continue to work if CapRover is removed.
  • Setup requires only the ability to copy and paste instructions from the “Getting Started” documentation.

🚀 Availability

Further details and documentation are available at https://CapRover.com/.

#PaaS #Docker #WebDevelopment #Deployment #OpenSource

Source: caprover/caprover

item.title: Introduction of Docker-Android for Android Development and Testing
item.description:
Introduction of Docker-Android for Android Development and Testing

Docker-Android is a docker image designed to support all aspects of Android development and testing, including native, web, and hybrid-app projects.

⚙️ Key details

Docker-Android provides the following capabilities:

  • Ability to build Android projects.
  • Execution of unit and UI-Tests using frameworks such as Espresso and Appium.
  • VNC support to view the inside of the docker container.
  • Log sharing feature via a web-UI.
  • External control of the emulator using adb connect.
  • Integration with cloud solutions, including Genymotion Cloud.
  • Support for mcp server (beta-version).

🚀 Availability

Various image tags are available:

  • budtmo/docker-android:emulator_9.0
  • budtmo/docker-android:emulator_10.0
  • budtmo/docker-android:emulator_11.0
  • budtmo/docker-android:emulator_12.0
  • budtmo/docker-android:emulator_13.0
  • budtmo/docker-android:emulator_14.0
  • budtmo/docker-android:genymotion
  • budtmo/docker-android:mcp

📱 Device Profiles

The emulator supports various device profiles and skins:
